title: A Job Interview
author: Hive
rights: 原创内容，Hive 站点所有，可随站使用。
intro: 这是一场初级软件开发工程师的求职面试。面试官请候选人先做自我介绍，接着聊项目经历、个人弱点、为什么想加入这个团队，最后请候选人提问。你可以选择面试官或候选人的角色来朗读。
tips: 谈弱点时语气要诚恳，再说明自己正在怎样改进。
提问部分句尾语调上扬，像真的对团队感兴趣。

segments.text: Thanks for coming in today. Could you start by telling us a little about yourself?
segments.speaker: Interviewer

segments.text: Of course. I'm a junior software developer, and I've been building web applications for about two years now.
segments.speaker: Candidate

segments.text: What kind of projects have you worked on so far?
segments.speaker: Interviewer

segments.text: The project I'm proudest of is a bug tracker for a small logistics team. I built the backend and most of the dashboard.
segments.speaker: Candidate

segments.text: Tell me about a time you ran into a hard technical problem. How did you handle it?
segments.speaker: Interviewer

segments.text: The dashboard slowed down when there was too much data. I added a simple queue, and the page loaded much faster after that.
segments.speaker: Candidate

segments.text: Everyone has weaknesses, so what would you say is yours?
segments.speaker: Interviewer

segments.text: I sometimes spend too long polishing my code before I ask for a review. Now I share smaller changes earlier, and I get feedback faster.
segments.speaker: Candidate

segments.text: I appreciate the honesty. Why are you interested in joining our team in particular?
segments.speaker: Interviewer

segments.text: Your team builds tools for schools, and I've always wanted to work on products that help teachers. I'd also like a team that does careful code reviews.
segments.speaker: Candidate

segments.text: Great. Do you have any questions for us before we wrap up?
segments.speaker: Interviewer

segments.text: Yes, how does the team usually plan its work each week? And how do new developers get started here?
segments.speaker: Candidate

segments.text: We use short sprints and a planning meeting on Monday. New hires pair with a mentor for the first month.
segments.speaker: Interviewer

segments.text: That sounds helpful. I'd love to learn how your team handles testing before code goes live.
segments.speaker: Candidate

segments.text: We'll definitely talk about that. Thank you for your time today, and we'll be in touch soon.
segments.speaker: Interviewer

segments.text: Thank you so much. I really enjoyed our conversation, and I look forward to hearing from you.
segments.speaker: Candidate
